items.html: Now, the Tiferet of Arich serves two phases: the upper part for Aba and Ima, and the lower part for ZA. Thus half of the six, which is three, is in the lower part of Tiferet, and from this three, three Mochin are made for ZA. Likewise, the Yesod of Atik, which is also hidden and clothed within the Tiferet of Arich, is also the phase of one Vav, and it too divides into two.
